headline: 合上电脑，云端任务继续跑
Close your laptop. Cloud tasks keep running.
scope: Cowork 的 Pro／Max 新任务转向云端。能否离开电脑，关键看任务是否还需要本机资源。
New Cowork tasks on Pro / Max run in the cloud. Whether you can leave your computer depends on the local resources the task needs.

title: 新任务在云端运行
New tasks run in the cloud
detail: Pro／Max 不再为新任务提供“仅在本机运行”选项。
Pro / Max no longer offer the local-only option for new tasks.

title: 新定时任务不必守电脑
New schedules can run offline
detail: 纯云端任务可在电脑离线时继续执行。
Cloud-only tasks can continue while your computer is offline.

title: 同一任务跨设备接续
Continue across devices
detail: 可在网页、桌面与手机查看进度、调整任务和接收结果。
View progress, steer tasks and receive results on web, desktop and mobile.

title: 经常切换设备的人
People switching devices
detail: 电脑发起任务，出门后用手机查看或接续。
Start at your desk, then check or continue on your phone.

title: 需要定时处理资料的人
People scheduling work
detail: 只依赖云端资源的任务，减少对本机持续在线的依赖。
Tasks using only cloud resources depend less on an always-online computer.

title: 本机资源仍需桌面在线
Local resources still need desktop
detail: 本机文件、本地连接器和部分浏览器操作，仍需桌面应用保持在线。
Local files, local connectors and some browser operations still require the desktop app to stay online.

title: 旧任务与团队套餐另看
Check older tasks and team plans
detail: 2026-10-06前的本机任务与定时任务仍留在本机；Team／Enterprise 另有 beta 与管理员条件。
Local tasks and schedules from before 2026-10-06 stay local. Team / Enterprise have separate beta and admin conditions.

next_step: 确认套餐和任务依赖，再用一个不访问本机资源的短任务，试一次跨设备接续。
Check your plan and task dependencies, then try continuing a short task across devices without local resources.

locator: 官方文档：云端任务、设备间接续、本机资源与旧任务说明。
Official documentation: cloud tasks, switching devices, local resources and existing tasks.

verification: 依据官方说明整理；本站未独立实测跨设备执行。
Based on official documentation; cross-device execution has not been independently tested by FieldToFit.

headline: ChatGPT 额度，可以接到 Devin 用
Use your ChatGPT allowance in Devin
scope: 适合已有 ChatGPT 与 Devin 付费套餐的人。连接后，部分 GPT 用量计入 ChatGPT 额度。
For people with eligible paid ChatGPT and Devin plans. Once connected, supported GPT usage counts toward your ChatGPT allowance.

title: 连接已有 ChatGPT 订阅
Connect your ChatGPT plan
detail: 在 Devin 的 Settings → Connections 授权，再打开 Use your ChatGPT plan。
Authorize in Devin Settings → Connections, then enable Use your ChatGPT plan.

title: 多个 Devin 入口适用
Available across Devin clients
detail: 连接开关适用于 Devin Cloud、Desktop 和 CLI，可关闭或解除连接。
The connection applies to Devin Cloud, Desktop and CLI. You can turn it off or disconnect.

title: 支持的 GPT 用量共享
Supported GPT usage is shared
detail: 符合条件的 GPT 调用使用 ChatGPT 额度，其他模型仍使用 Devin 用量。
Eligible GPT calls use your ChatGPT allowance; other models still use Devin usage.

title: 同时订阅两边的开发者
Developers with both plans
detail: 可把已有 ChatGPT 额度用于 Devin 的编程任务。
Use an existing ChatGPT allowance for coding tasks in Devin.

title: 需要核对用量的团队
Teams tracking usage
detail: 连接前先分清每种模型使用哪边额度。
Identify which allowance each model uses before connecting.

title: 两边套餐都要符合条件
Both plans must be eligible
detail: ChatGPT Go／Plus／Pro 配 Devin Pro／Max／Teams；不含 Devin Free／Enterprise，也不赠送 Devin 订阅。
ChatGPT Go / Plus / Pro with Devin Pro / Max / Teams. Devin Free / Enterprise are excluded; no Devin subscription is included.

title: 留意例外与自动回退
Watch exceptions and fallback
detail: fast／priority 变体除外；ChatGPT 额度耗尽或不可用时，回退 Devin 额度，再使用按需点数。
fast / priority variants are excluded. If ChatGPT usage is exhausted or unavailable, Devin usage is used, followed by on-demand credits.

next_step: 连接前确认两边套餐、模型选择与 Devin 按需用量设置，再用一个小任务观察实际扣量。
Check both plans, model selection and Devin on-demand settings, then inspect usage on a small task.

locator: Devin 官方文档：套餐资格、连接步骤、支持模型与用量回退。
Devin documentation: eligibility, connection steps, supported models and usage fallback.

verification: 依据 Devin 官方说明整理；本站未独立试用或核对实际账单。
Based on Devin documentation; FieldToFit has not independently tried the connection or verified actual billing.

headline: Haiku 升级，先检查迁移与预算
Upgrading Haiku? Check migration and budget first.
scope: Haiku 5.5 面向分类、路由、提取等高频任务。新能力可用，旧调用配置与费用估算需要重看。
Haiku 5.5 targets frequent classification, routing and extraction tasks. Review existing request settings and cost estimates before using the new capabilities.

title: 更长的输入与输出
Longer input and output
detail: 型号 claude-haiku-5-5：1M 上下文，最高 128K 输出。
Model claude-haiku-5-5: 1M context and up to 128K output.

title: 默认自适应思考
Adaptive thinking by default
detail: 旧 budget_tokens 配置会报错，需要按新接口调整。
The old budget_tokens setting causes an error; update the request for the new interface.

title: 重新核算 token 数
Recount tokens
detail: 新分词器可能增加相同文本的 token 数，不能只按旧用量估算费用。
The new tokenizer may increase token counts for the same text. Do not estimate cost using old counts alone.

title: 高频 API 任务维护者
High-volume API maintainers
detail: 用真实分类、提取样本比较质量、延迟和任务费用。
Compare quality, latency and task cost on real classification and extraction samples.

title: 维护旧 Haiku 集成的人
Maintainers of older integrations
detail: 优先检查请求参数与返回内容的解析方式。
Inspect request parameters and response parsing first.

title: 不要固定读取第一块
Do not assume the first block is text
detail: 按内容块类型读取回答；单价变化不等于整项任务费用同比变化。
Read responses by content block type. A unit-price change does not imply the same change in total task cost.

title: 平台与长上下文要分开核对
Check platforms and context tiers
detail: Claude API 与云平台能力分别确认；标准输入／输出价格有 ≤100K 和 >100K 提示长度分档。
Check Claude API and cloud platforms separately. Standard input / output prices have separate tiers for prompts of ≤100K and >100K tokens.

next_step: 先在测试环境迁移一个典型任务，记录输入输出 token、质量与费用，再决定是否扩大替换。
Migrate one representative task in a test environment. Record input and output tokens, quality and cost before expanding the rollout.

locator: Haiku 5.5 官方迁移说明：上下文、思考参数、内容块与分词器变化。
Official Haiku 5.5 migration guide: context, thinking parameters, content blocks and tokenizer changes.

verification: 依据官方说明整理；本站未独立复测性能、迁移或任务费用。
Based on official documentation; FieldToFit has not independently tested performance, migration or per-task cost.
